title: Trust Protocol: on-chain identity bonds for autonomous AI agents
summary: Initialise the Trust Protocol with a SWORN mint, then read the protocol-config and insurance-pool PDAs that later identity bonds and contracts hang off.
what: Trust Protocol is an open Anchor program for autonomous AI-agent reputation on Solana. An admin initialises a protocol-config PDA (SWORN mint, min/max identity bond, fee and governance parameters) and an insurance-pool PDA. Agents later lock a SWORN identity bond, bid on contracts, deliver work, and can be disputed or claim insurance. Upstream is the program only; the hosted app is Sol.College's generic IDL console pointed at this devnet deployment.
app_note: The fork has no first-party frontend. The page at /dapps/trust-protocol/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

diagram:
admin ─ create SWORN mint (6 decimals)
admin ─ initialize(min_bond, max_bond) ─▶ ProtocolConfig ["protocol-config"] + InsurancePool ["insurance-pool"]
(later) agent ─ register_agent(bond) ─▶ identity PDA + transfer SWORN into bond vault
accounts: Global config: admin, SWORN mint, bond bounds, fees, governance_phase, counters.
Pool state: balances, claims, authority (the pool-authority PDA).
Unchecked PDA used as the insurance pool's authority. Not created as an account at initialize.
Existing SPL Mint (6 decimals in the whitepaper)
Passed into initialize; later identity bonds and fees are in this mint.

instructions.name: initialize
steps: Admin-signed, once-only. Writes protocol_config (admin, sworn_mint, min/max identity bond, default fee and governance parameters) and insurance_pool (zero balances, authority = pool-authority PDA).
Does not create a token vault. That is a later setup_bond_vault / migrate_bond_vault step.

instructions.name: register_agent
steps: Agent signs, posts a bond_amount of SWORN into a bond vault, and initialises an identity account.
Not exercised in this run: the vault must exist and the agent ATA must be funded. setup_bond_vault uses seed bond-vault; register_agent reads bond-vault-v2.

innovation.title: A shared on-chain trust layer for AI agents, not just a payment allowance
innovation.text: Identity bonds, contract bidding, delivery, disputes and an insurance pool are all in one program, with SWORN as the unit of stake. That is the interesting DeAI idea — agents that can be held to a bond — even though this lab run only proves the initialize foundation.
innovation.more: register_agent, contracts, disputes and insurance were not sent in this run. There is a seed mismatch between setup_bond_vault (bond-vault) and register_agent (bond-vault-v2).

frontend.title: Generic IDL console
steps: initialize is already confirmed on this deployment; fetch protocol_config.
Later instructions (register_agent, contracts) need a SWORN vault and funded ATAs.

exercises.title: Derive the protocol-config PDA
steps: Use seeds ["protocol-config"] and the program id EaqMCxECSfFKPtEUPEYtB8prCxb9mgpeuB4YH2JtF71f.
Compare with the address created on devnet.
exercises.hint: A single constant seed, no pubkey bytes.

exercises.title: Why can't initialize run twice?
steps: Read the account constraints on protocol_config and insurance_pool.
Explain what happens if a second admin tries initialize.
exercises.expect: Both accounts use init, so a second call fails because the PDAs already exist.
exercises.hint: Look at the init / seeds attributes in Initialize.

exercises.title: Find the bond-vault seed mismatch
steps: Compare the PDA seeds on setup_bond_vault and register_agent.
exercises.expect: setup_bond_vault uses bond-vault; register_agent uses bond-vault-v2. A migrate_bond_vault instruction exists.
exercises.hint: Search the IDL or the Rust for bond-vault.
exercises.approach: Read the IDL accounts or setup_bond_vault / register_agent / migrate_bond_vault.

not_covered: register_agent, contracts, disputes and insurance were not sent: they need a bond vault and a funded SWORN ATA. The hosted UI was not clicked in headless Chromium in this run.
objectives: Explain what initialize writes to the protocol-config and insurance-pool PDAs.
Derive those PDAs from the documented seeds and the lab program id.
State why a second initialize fails and what is still needed before register_agent.
prereqs: A wallet on devnet with a little SOL (initialize pays rent for two PDAs).
Comfort with PDAs, Anchor init constraints, and SPL mints.
